svg.title: Two teams as bars of the mean and as individual tickets
svg.desc: Left: two bars of almost equal height with overlapping intervals. Right: the tickets show that Team A's cluster around 20 hours while Team B's split into quick fixes near 8 hours and escalations near 43 hours.
